read.en: Coherent jumped 13.6% on Nov 6 to $192.81, trading $179.05–195.67 on heavy volume. It closed just under the falling 5-day ($193.0) and below the falling 10-day ($211.0), 30-day ($256.4), 100-day ($295.9) and 200-day ($296.4) averages. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($233.40), and RSI is 37.
read.zh: Coherent 11月6日大涨 13.6%，收于 $192.81，盘中区间 $179.05–195.67，成交量明显放大。收盘略低于下行的 5 日均线（$193.0），并位于下行的 10 日（$211.0）、30 日（$256.4）、100 日（$295.9）和 200 日均线（$296.4）下方。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方，处于零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$233.40），RSI 为 37。

read.en: The rebound reclaimed $180 and the $187.2–189.6 area (Nov 4 low, late-December lows), now support. Resistance is $193–198.6 (5-day, Nov 6 high, Nov 2 low), then $203.6–203.9 (Oct 23 and Oct 30 lows) and $211 (10-day). Support is $187.2–189.6, then $179–180 and $167.5–168.6. A close above $198.6 would target $203.6–211; below $187.2, $179–180.
